items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued June 20 at 2:20PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
Saturday afternoon hot temperatures continue to impact most of the
Central and Eastern Interior, with high temperatures climbing back
into the 80s. Take caution when participating in outdoor
activities. Stay hydrated and limit strenuous outdoor activity in
the afternoon when temperatures are the highest.

items.headline: Heat Advisory issued June 20 at 1:25PM AKDT until June 20 at 8:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures up to the low 80s.

* WHERE...Annette Island, City of Hyder, Haines Borough and Klukwan,
Ketchikan Gateway Borough, and Prince of Wales Island.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.

items.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that conditions are occurring or will
occur which could lead to the development of large and dangerous
fires. It is directed toward fire agencies, and through them, to
the public.

Please advise the appropriate officials or fire crews in the
field of this Red Flag Warning.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued June 19 at 3:39PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
Friday afternoon into Sunday, the majority of the Central and
Eastern Interior will see highs near/above 80F. Take caution while
participating in outdoor activities planned for the
solstice/holiday weekend. Stay hydrated and limit strenuous
outdoor activities in the afternoon when temperatures are the
highest.
